bibl.title: Agonistic terminology in Christian Nubia.
bibl.seg: Adam Łajtar, Agonistic terminology in Christian Nubia.
U Schyłku Starożytności. Studia Źródłoznawcze [Late Antiquity. Studies in Source Criticism] 19 (2020) pp. 261-273.
bibl.note: Agonistic terms can be found in the epitaphs of two bishops of Faras (Pachoras): I. Faras Gr. 4 = I. Varsovie 106 (AD 802); I. Khartoum Copt. 3 (AD 972). They hailed from the same tradition of perceiving the monastic life as a fight.
